title.zh: 亚庇 · 一生一次的日落

intro.zh:
前几天一直是阴天。
到最后一个傍晚，整片海忽然亮了起来。
intro.en:
The first few days stayed grey.
Then, on our final evening, the whole sea lit up.

title.en: A Night Flight to the Tropics

subtitle.zh: 11 月 25 日—26 日 · 上海 ✈ 亚庇

detail.zh: 夜里飞往沙巴，约四个半小时
detail.en: A four-and-a-half-hour night flight to Sabah

event.en: Landed at Kota Kinabalu International Airport

detail.zh: 凌晨入住丹绒亚路香格里拉
detail.en: Checked into Shangri-La Tanjung Aru after midnight

event.en: Our first look at Kota Kinabalu

detail.zh: 阴沉的天空，浓绿园林、棕榈树和远处海面
detail.en: Grey sky, dense gardens, palms, and the sea beyond

caption.zh: 第一眼亚庇：天色阴阴的，热带植物却绿得很精神
caption.en: First look at Kota Kinabalu: grey overhead, brilliantly green below

body.zh: 前两天是我和小欧的双人闲逛；27 日晚上，小土和 Ellie 夫妇抵达。Rock 在后半程加入。人数一点点变多，旅行也从安静散步切换成热闹聚餐。
body.en: The first two days were just Xiao Ou and me. Xiao Tu and Ellie's party arrived on the evening of the 27th, and Rock joined later. The trip gradually shifted from quiet wandering to full-table dinners.

title.en: A Morning That Began with Noodles

subtitle.zh: 11 月 26 日 · Kinabalu Kopitiam · 市中心

paragraphs.zh: 睡醒后随手叫车出门，没有很严密的计划。第一站是金纳巴鲁咖啡店，桌上很快摆满汤粉、牛肉丸和凤爪。热气腾腾的一顿，把夜航留下的疲惫慢慢压了下去。
paragraphs.en: We woke without much of a plan and called a car into town. At Kinabalu Kopitiam, soup noodles, beef balls, and chicken feet quickly filled the table. A hot, straightforward breakfast slowly pushed away the night-flight fatigue.

caption.zh: 家常而扎实的第一顿
caption.en: A hearty, homestyle first meal

caption.zh: 凤爪也要点上
caption.en: Chicken feet, of course

paragraphs.zh: 到市中心商场一带继续闲晃，在 Crack Inc. Borneo Coffee Roastery 点了奶咖和黑咖。没有赶景点，喝咖啡、看街景，就是当天最自然的节奏。
paragraphs.en: We drifted through the downtown malls and stopped at Crack Inc. Borneo Coffee Roastery for an iced milk coffee and a black coffee. No landmark chase—just coffee, streets, and whatever caught our eye.

caption.zh: 双人骑车 logo，很有辨识度
caption.en: The tandem-bike logo was hard to miss

caption.zh: 犀鸟、猴子和本地符号挤满整面墙
caption.en: Hornbills, monkeys, and local symbols across one wall

title.en: Streets, a Massage, and Fried Chicken

subtitle.zh: 11 月 26 日 · Wisma Sabah · Lara Spa

caption.zh: 随手记下的城市切片
caption.en: A small slice of the city

caption.zh: 没有目的地地走
caption.en: Walking without a destination

caption.zh: 云层一直压在楼顶
caption.en: Clouds pressed low over the rooftops

paragraphs.zh: 中午以后去 Lara Spa 做按摩。小店干净温馨，墙上的 “keep calm & get your spa day on” 很应景。按摩结束继续逛商场，晚上索性用一盒 Jollibee 炸鸡收尾。
paragraphs.en: After lunch came a massage at Lara Spa, a clean, welcoming little place whose “keep calm & get your spa day on” sign felt entirely appropriate. We wandered some more, then ended the night with a box of Jollibee fried chicken.

caption.zh: 第一天的松弛感，从这里开始
caption.en: This was where the holiday loosened its shoulders

caption.zh: 简单直接的商场晚餐
caption.en: A simple mall-food dinner

title.zh: 📝 没有被账单记住的一天

body.zh: 早茶、咖啡、按摩、炸鸡和几段打车的金额后来都找不到了。与其补一个看似精确的数字，不如留下这条缺口。
body.en: We later lost track of the exact prices for breakfast, coffee, massage, fried chicken, and several rides. Better to leave the gap than invent precise-looking numbers.

subtitle.zh: 11 月 27 日 · 香格里拉 · 亚燕 · 海滨步道

caption.zh: 云很多，度假感却一点不少
caption.en: Plenty of cloud, but no shortage of holiday mood

caption.zh: 在园林里晃到不想出门
caption.en: The gardens made leaving difficult

paragraphs.zh: 早餐后就在度假村里散步。无边泳池中央那棵树很抢眼，远处还能看见岛的轮廓。中午还是去了市区，在亚燕吃一碗橙红浓郁的汤面——大虾、豆腐卜、蛋丝和香菜挤得满满，是真的好吃。
paragraphs.en: After breakfast we stayed around the resort. A lone tree stood in the infinity pool, with islands faintly visible beyond. Lunch pulled us downtown: at Ah Yan, an orange-red bowl arrived crowded with prawns, tofu puffs, egg, and herbs. It was genuinely delicious.

caption.zh: 这趟旅行里会想念的一碗面
caption.en: The bowl I would happily return for

caption.zh: 电影散场后，天终于亮了一些
caption.en: After the film, the sky finally brightened

body.zh: 下午在商场看了《疯狂动物城》，评价很不错。旅行里插入一场电影，意外地很适合阴天。
body.en: We watched Zootopia at the mall and liked it a lot. A cinema break fitted the cloudy afternoon surprisingly well.

subtitle.zh: 11 月 27 日 · Imago · 第二家 Spa

paragraphs.zh: 去另一家 Spa 的路上，一架客机从市中心建筑上方低低掠过。那家店的名字已经不记得，环境普通，但约 180 多元人民币的价格很便宜。晚餐回到 Imago，排队吃了一家泰国菜，门口的小突突车比店名更让人记得住。
paragraphs.en: On our walk to another spa, a passenger jet swept low over the city buildings. I no longer remember the spa's name; it was basic, but cheap at a little over RMB 180. Dinner was at a Thai restaurant in Imago after a long queue. Its tuk-tuk display proved more memorable than its name.

caption.zh: 亚庇机场离城很近，抬头就是飞机腹部
caption.en: The airport is close enough for a clear view of the belly

caption.zh: 店名忘了，门口的车还记得
caption.en: The name faded; the tuk-tuk stayed

caption.zh: 炒空心菜
caption.en: Morning glory

caption.zh: 红咖喱
caption.en: Red curry

caption.zh: 炸鸡翅
caption.en: Fried wings

caption.zh: 热带城市也进入了圣诞季
caption.en: Even the tropics had entered Christmas season

paragraphs.zh: 晚上，小土和 Ellie 夫妇抵达。两个人的闲逛告一段落，大部队正式汇合。
paragraphs.en: Xiao Tu and Ellie's party arrived that evening. The two-person chapter was over; the full group had assembled.

subtitle.zh: 11 月 28 日 · 大茄来 · Tiya Spa

paragraphs.zh: 人齐以后，行程很自然地变成吃吃喝喝。中午去大茄来，黑胡椒蟹、白灼虾、清蒸鱼、炸豆腐和广式点心铺满一桌，是毫不收敛的一顿。
paragraphs.en: Once everyone arrived, the day naturally became a food crawl. At Welcome Seafood, black-pepper crab, poached prawns, steamed fish, tofu, vegetables, and Cantonese dim sum covered the table. Nothing restrained about this lunch.

caption.zh: 黑胡椒酱汁裹住每一块蟹
caption.en: Black-pepper sauce in every crevice

caption.zh: 简单白灼，虾本身就够鲜
caption.en: Simply poached and naturally sweet

caption.zh: 大部队的第一顿正式聚餐
caption.en: The first full-group feast

caption.zh: 海鲜桌上还塞进了整套早茶
caption.en: A complete dim sum spread beside the seafood

paragraphs.zh: 下午看《惊天魔盗团 3》，感觉一般，有点炒冷饭。晚上全员去 Tiya Spa 做 90 分钟精油按摩；偏偏我有点感冒，趴着的时候并不舒服，再漂亮的圣诞装饰也救不了鼻塞。
paragraphs.en: Now You See Me 3 came next—average, a little too much like reheated material. In the evening, everyone booked a 90-minute oil massage at Tiya Spa. I had a cold, so lying face-down was mostly uncomfortable. Even the Christmas decorations could not rescue a blocked nose.

caption.zh: 店里已经很圣诞，我却只想赶紧把感冒睡过去
caption.en: The spa felt festive; I mostly wanted to sleep off the cold

subtitle.zh: 11 月 29 日 · New WK · 水上清真寺

paragraphs.zh: 中午专门跑去 New WK 吃早茶。虾饺、烧卖、叉烧包、豉汁蒸排骨一笼笼上桌，皮薄馅足，值得为它离开熟悉的商场范围。
paragraphs.en: We travelled farther for lunch at New WK. Basket after basket brought har gow, siu mai, char siu buns, and steamed ribs. Thin wrappers, generous fillings—worth leaving our familiar mall orbit for.

caption.zh: 这一顿真的很棒，是愿意专门跑一趟的味道
caption.en: A meal worth making a dedicated trip for

paragraphs.zh: 下午去亚庇水上清真寺。白色主体、蓝绿色穹顶和四座尖塔落在水面倒影里。大家换上清真寺提供的袍子，认真参观，也认真拍照。
paragraphs.en: In the afternoon we visited Masjid Bandaraya Kota Kinabalu, the City Mosque. Its white walls, blue-green dome, and four minarets sat reflected in the water. We changed into the provided robes, took time to look around, and took plenty of photographs too.

caption.zh: 亚庇最有辨识度的一组线条
caption.en: The city's most recognisable silhouette

caption.zh: 靠近后才看清拱门和金色点缀
caption.en: The arches and gold details appeared up close

title.en: Robes, Group Photos, and Gaya Street

subtitle.zh: 11 月 29 日 · 清真寺 · Gorilla · 夜市
subtitle.en: November 29 · City Mosque · Gorilla · Night Market

caption.zh: 清真寺前的大合影
caption.en: The big mosque group photo

caption.zh: 米色与灰色长袍
caption.en: Beige and grey robes

caption.zh: 紫色圆帽也很抢镜
caption.en: The purple cap stole some attention

paragraphs.zh: 傍晚到加雅街的 Gorilla Restaurant。黑白花砖、藤编吊灯和绿植把店里挤得很热闹。吃完并没有立刻回去，又在夜市路边分食一盒炒粉，举着冰饮碰杯。
paragraphs.en: Evening took us to Gorilla Restaurant near Gaya Street, all patterned tiles, woven lights, greenery, and noise. Dinner did not stop us from sharing a foam box of fried noodles at the night market—or raising brightly coloured iced drinks for a toast.

caption.zh: 热闹的南洋餐厅内部
caption.en: A lively, tropical dining room

caption.zh: 正餐以后，路边这一盒还是吃得下
caption.en: Still room for this box after dinner

caption.zh: 冰饮碰杯，人数终于完整
caption.en: A toast with the whole crew

caption.zh: 小欧在亚庇的最后一个完整晚上
caption.en: Xiao Ou's last full evening in Kota Kinabalu

body.zh: 小欧 29 日一整天都和大家在一起，直到 30 日凌晨才先行离开。最后一天，队伍变成我、小土和 Ellie 夫妇四人。
body.en: Xiao Ou stayed with us throughout the 29th and left in the early hours of the 30th. The final day belonged to Xiao Tu, Ellie's party, and me.

title.zh: 天气终于站在我们这边
title.en: The Weather Finally Chose Our Side

subtitle.zh: 11 月 30 日 · 酒店码头 · 东姑阿都拉曼公园
subtitle.en: November 30 · Hotel Jetty · Tunku Abdul Rahman Park

caption.zh: 前几天的阴云终于散开
caption.en: The clouds of the previous days finally cleared

caption.zh: 出海前沿着酒店海边走一圈
caption.en: One seaside walk before the boat

paragraphs.zh: 临时决定跟酒店的船出海。岛名后来没有确认，只记得它在东姑阿都拉曼公园一带。码头前先合影，登艇后四个人穿着救生衣又拍一张，蓝天、远山和亚庇海岸线都在背后。
paragraphs.en: We made a last-minute decision to join the hotel's island trip. I never confirmed the island's name, only that it was around Tunku Abdul Rahman Park. First a photo at the jetty, then another aboard the speedboat: four life jackets, blue sky, distant hills, and the city shoreline behind us.

caption.zh: 终于等到适合出海的蓝天
caption.en: At last, a properly blue day for the islands

caption.zh: 出海小分队，正式出发
caption.en: The island crew, underway

subtitle.zh: 11 月 30 日 · 小岛浮潜 · 酒店退房

caption.zh: 岛名没记住，海水的颜色记住了
caption.en: I forgot the name, but not the colour of the water

caption.zh: 浮潜归来的纪念照
caption.en: The post-snorkel souvenir photo

paragraphs.zh: 海水清澈，白沙滩后是树林与红顶小屋。我们下水浮潜，具体看见了什么已经说不准确，就不替记忆补答案了。下午回酒店退房，又游了一会儿泳、泡了池子。
paragraphs.en: Clear water met a pale beach, with trees and red-roofed huts behind it. We snorkelled, though I cannot now say exactly what we saw underwater, so I will not fill in the memory for effect. Back at the hotel, we checked out, swam a little longer, and soaked in the pool.

paragraphs.zh: 香格里拉很贴心：退房后仍能使用行政酒廊，洗澡、换衣、寄存行李都不成问题。于是我们一直赖到傍晚，等这趟旅行最后一场重头戏。
paragraphs.en: Shangri-La let us keep using the Horizon Club after checkout—for showers, clean clothes, luggage, and a place to wait. We stayed until evening for the final event of the trip.

caption.zh: 退房以后，泳池和行政酒廊又替我们收留了半天
caption.en: The pool and lounge gave us half a day after checkout

body.zh: 上岛费记录为 MYR 110（四人），但酒店船费和浮潜装备另计，金额已经记不清，没有算进最终合计。
body.en: The island fee was recorded as MYR 110 for four people. The hotel boat and snorkelling equipment cost extra, but the amount is gone from memory and therefore absent from the total.

subtitle.zh: 11 月 30 日 · 丹绒亚路

paragraphs.zh: 傍晚，云层终于没有再把光挡住。深蓝与橙金从海面一直铺向天空，水波被夕阳拉成一条条金线。前几天一直阴着，或许正因为等得够久，这场日落才显得像只会发生一次。
paragraphs.en: At dusk the clouds finally stopped holding back the light. Deep blue and molten orange spread from sea to sky, each ripple stretched into a line of gold. Perhaps it felt singular because we had waited through so many grey days.

caption.zh: 海和天空同时被点亮
caption.en: The sea and sky lit up together

caption.zh: 海面接住了整片橙金晚霞
caption.en: The sea caught the full orange-gold sky

caption.zh: 四个人，最后一个完整傍晚
caption.en: Four people, one last full evening

caption.zh: 所有人都在等同一片天空
caption.en: Everyone waiting beneath the same sky

caption.zh: 日落把人群变成剪影
caption.en: The sunset turned the crowd into silhouettes

caption.zh: 泳池也安静下来
caption.en: The pool quietened with the light

alt.zh: 黄昏时酒店无边泳池与海面
alt.en: Hotel infinity pool and sea at dusk

body.zh: 不是追着行程赶来的日落，而是在酒店待到最后、刚好等到的日落。它替整趟旅行收了一个太漂亮的尾。
body.en: This was not a sunset we rushed across town to catch. We simply stayed at the hotel until the end and happened to receive it—a spectacular closing line.

title.en: Seafood, Durian, and a 1 AM Flight

subtitle.zh: 11 月 30 日—12 月 1 日 · 加雅街 · 机场

paragraphs.zh: 看完日落又回到加雅街附近的大茄来。酱蒸鱼铺满胡萝卜丝和葱花，麦片虾咸甜酥脆，最后一顿正餐吃得很满足。
paragraphs.en: After sunset we returned to Welcome Seafood near Gaya Street. Sauce covered the whole steamed fish beneath carrot and spring onion; cereal prawns came crisp, savoury, and sweet. A satisfying last proper meal.

caption.zh: 浓酱铺满整条鱼
caption.en: Rich sauce across the whole fish

caption.zh: 最后一顿还要点麦片虾
caption.en: Cereal prawns for the final dinner

paragraphs.zh: Rock 当晚另开了一间房，方便飞台湾前洗整，我们也借地方简单梳洗。深夜临时下楼，在 MK DURIAN 撞见一摊好榴莲：果肉金黄饱满，质量惊艳。凌晨一点去机场，六点落地北京，旅程结束得干脆。
paragraphs.en: Rock had booked a room before his flight to Taiwan, and we borrowed it for a quick shower and reset. Downstairs, an unplanned visit to MK DURIAN produced excellent fruit—golden, plump, and intensely fragrant. At 1 AM we flew out; by 6 AM we were back in Beijing.

caption.zh: 计划外的最后一口，反而格外惊艳
caption.en: The unplanned final bite was one of the best

detail.zh: 洗澡、换衣，准备各自的凌晨航班
detail.en: Shower, change, then separate early flights

detail.zh: 打车去机场 MYR 28.84，三人分摊
detail.en: Airport ride MYR 28.84, split among three

detail.zh: 从热带日落回到冬天
detail.en: From a tropical sunset back to winter

subtitle.zh: 仅统计能够确认的共同支出
subtitle.en: Confirmed expenses for Xiao Tu and me only

label.zh: 12 月 1 日机场交通分摊

body.zh: 这是“我 + 小土”的共同支出合计，不是人均。11 月 26—27 日的大部分消费、约 180 多元的第二家 Spa，以及酒店船费和浮潜装备因为记录不完整，没有纳入合计。
body.en: This is the combined spend for Xiao Tu and me, not a per-person figure. Most spending from November 26–27, the roughly RMB 180 second spa, and the hotel boat and snorkelling equipment remain outside the total because the records are incomplete.

label.zh: 最诚实：感冒时按摩并不享受
label.en: Most honest: a cold ruined the massage

paragraphs.zh:
有些店名和数字已经模糊，
但那天海面上的金光，应该会记很久。
paragraphs.en:
Some names and numbers have blurred,
but the gold across that sea should stay for a long time.
